# Calendar

A month grid for picking a date or a range.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Readers need sections, navigation and little else. Actions are rare: subscribe, share, save. Picking dates is not one of them. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./input">Input</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Dates near today, ranges, or when the day of the week matters.
- **Not when:** A date people know by heart, such as a birth date: typed fields are faster.

Instead:

- [Date picker](./date-picker.md): A calendar opened from a field, in a popover.
- [Input](./input.md): A known date typed in.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between days; Page Up and Page Down change month. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a grid; the selected and today's dates are announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add calendar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
